title: Talking Trees: Reasoning-Assisted Induction of Decision Trees for Tabular Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD), and ABCFair violation scores on the Adult and SchoolPerformance datasets after using natural language prompts to steer an LLM agent toward creating gender-neutral decision trees.
Measuring unintended spillover bias effects on the 'parental_education' attribute in the SchoolPerformance dataset using the ABCFair benchmark's parallel and intersectional violation scores.
